script_text: Libra, as an Air sign ruled by Venus, Saturn stationing retrograde in Pisces rewrites your emotional contracts this week. Early week finds the Sun trine Jupiter in Aries sparking a career breakthrough opportunity on Monday and Tuesday. However, Mercury square Saturn in Gemini on Wednesday will freeze all communication — delay signing anything that day. The turning point arrives Thursday when Venus enters Cancer and lands in your 4th House, flooding your romantic life with tenderness and deep emotional security with your partner. Thursday night through Sunday pulses with intuitive clarity as the Moon crosses Pisces into Aries, unlocking creative money channels by Saturday. Your best day is Saturday — Jupiter sextile natal Venus opens unexpected abundance in your 1st House. Wednesday is your worst day — Mercury square Saturn shuts down every negotiation path. Speak your boundaries calmly this week without over-explaining. Follow for your daily updates.
